exampleEn: Don't be afraid to speak up during the meeting.
exampleKo: 회의 중에 목소리를 높이는 걸 두려워하지 마세요.
gameExamples: If you have an opinion, you should speak up and share it.
The teacher encouraged the shy students to speak up when they have questions.
In a group discussion, it's important to speak up so everyone can hear your views.
